MERGE INTO MATCH M USING (SELECT LEAST(#{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{target, jdbcType=INTEGER}) as u1, GREATEST(#{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{target, jdbcType=INTEGER}) as u2 FROM DUAL) TMP ON (M.USER1_IDX = TMP.u1 AND M.USER2_IDX = TMP.u2) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
CHAT_APPLICANT = #{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, IS_CHAT = 'N' MATCH_APPLICANT = #{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, IS_MATCH = 'N'
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MATCH_IDX, USER1_IDX, USER2_IDX, CHAT_APPLICANT, IS_CHAT, MATCH_APPLICANT, IS_MATCH) VALUES (SEQ_MATCH.NEXTVAL, TMP.u1, TMP.u2,
#{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'N', NULL, 'N' NULL, 'N', #{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'N' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (NOTI_IDX, RECEIVER_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, IS_READ, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_NOTIFICATION.NEXTVAL, #{target, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{me, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{notiType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT A.user_idx, A.coach_idx, A.nickname, A.photo, A.intro, A.video, ROUND(NVL(AVG(rt.rating), 0), 1) AS rating, COUNT(rt.content) AS review_count, (SELECT CASE WHEN IS_CHAT = 'Y' THEN 'ACCEPTED' WHEN CHAT_APPLICANT = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_CHAT = 'N' THEN 'APPLIED' WHEN CHAT_APPLICANT != #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_CHAT = 'N' THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM MATCH WHERE (USER1_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND USER2_IDX = A.user_idx) OR (USER1_IDX = A.user_idx AND USER2_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER})) as chatStatus, (SELECT CASE WHEN IS_MATCH = 'Y' THEN 'ACCEPTED' WHEN MATCH_APPLICANT = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_MATCH = 'N' THEN 'APPLIED' WHEN MATCH_APPLICANT != #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND IS_MATCH = 'N' THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM MATCH WHERE (USER1_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND USER2_IDX = A.user_idx) OR (USER1_IDX = A.user_idx AND USER2_IDX = #{login_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER})) as matchStatus FROM coach A LEFT JOIN review_coach rt ON A.user_idx = rt.reviewee_idx WHERE A.user_idx = #{target_idx, jdbcType=INTEGER} GROUP BY A.user_idx, A.coach_idx, A.nickname, A.photo, A.intro, A.video
